visual_review: Centered table headers, short entries and numeric cells; paragraph cells left aligned; table endings bound and short HTML header line breaks removed; representative table pages inspected.
text_extraction_method: PDFKit line selections sorted by page coordinates; headers/footers excluded
table_alignment_policy: 表头、短文本、数字及费率在单元格内水平和垂直居中；大段说明左对齐；取消短表头的固定换行，并约束各段末尾断行，避免末行仅余一两个字。
